summary: Opus review of the M1 diff (1065 lines): 0 Critical, 5 Important, 9 Minor; no second round. Fixed all 5 Important and Minor 6-8 test-first: forward-only import, one-line 200-char titles, a cap keeping every id·status, JSONL skip + {more:n}, LEDGER_COMMIT=1 run check, no symlinked proposals, unlistable store noted. Stray .tmp removed. Tests 413 → 420.
verified_how: Each new check red then green: `backlog import: a re-import keeps a later status and the links the row lacks (status never moves back)`, `backlog merge: a title's newlines and control characters fold to one space, at most 200 characters`, `backlog validate: the why line of a huge bad id stays under 300 bytes`, `backlog list: past --max-bytes every row keeps its id and status, full lines first`, `backlog list --jsonl: a row too big is skipped, not the rest; a cut list ends with a {"more": n} line`, `backlog run: a symlinked retro-proposals.json is not followed, and a store that will not list is noted`; `backlog run: with LEDGER_COMMIT=1 the run's ledger commit carries retro-backlog.jsonl with its proposal` red with the paths+= line removed, green restored. bash -n on the six named files, node --check lib/backlog.mjs. check.sh green in 229 s, 420 tests.

dead_ends.tried: noting an unlistable store before the retro session
dead_ends.why: restrict reverts harness-log.md edits made after rstart; the note is now written after restrict

discoveries.text: Any note() written in retro() between rstart and restrict is reverted with the retro's edits: write it after restrict (as S_NOTES are).
backlog.mjs exports oneLine (whitespace and control characters folded, 200 chars): reuse it for any retro-written text that reaches a prompt.
